#Kubernetes 1.34 reaches end of life on Oct 27, but EKS, GKE and AKS each act on their own dates. #EKS can force-upgrade the control plane without notice once extended support ends. #GKE holds back clusters that use an API the next minor removes, until end of support forces the upgrade. #AKS leaves the cluster running without security patches.

Check which date applies to each of your clusters before it passes. Sources, dates and commands: https://radarhq.io/blog/kubernetes-1-34-end-of-life?utm_source=mastodon&utm_campaign=kubernetes-1-34-end-of-life-launch-2026-10&utm_content=masto
